name: process
description: Manage background jobs of this session: servers, watchers and other long commands. One action per call. Start: {"action":"start","command":"npm run dev","label":"Dev server"} returns the job id. Then {"action":"output","id":"<id>"} reads new output (pass the returned next cursor as cursor to continue), {"action":"status","id":"<id>"} shows its state, {"action":"stop","id":"<id>"} ends its process group, and {"action":"list"} lists jobs. Jobs keep running across turns; a started job is not yet known to be ready, so read its output. Limits: 8 live jobs per session, 1 MiB of recent output per job.

command.description: start: the Bash command to run.

id.description: status, output, stop: the job id returned by start.

cwd.description: start: directory relative to the session cwd.

label.description: start: a short title for the job.

timeout.description: start: stop the job after this many milliseconds; no limit when omitted.

cursor.description: output: the next cursor from an earlier page.

max_bytes.description: output: the most bytes to return.

env_refs.description: start: map child environment names to selected Raw variable names; values are references, not literal values.
